plan: Represent all adaptation state in one accumulator (_Ctx): ordered chosen catalog IDs, warning set, reason set, ordered wording changes, equipment add/remove sets, and a yield-correction Fraction.

Resolve each ingredient with a loop that rewrites it while its name is excluded, selecting the catalog candidate sorted by (priority, catalog index) for determinism; carry the chain of replaced names to detect cycles and to warn when an exclusion is reintroduced but resolvable.
Recurse additional ingredients from substitution results through the same resolver with the inherited chain, so chained adaptations and reintroduced exclusions are handled uniformly.

Never abort on first failure: every top-level ingredient and every equipment item contributes reasons independently; decide possible/impossible only after all reasons are gathered, then sort and deduplicate reasons and warnings.

Scale quantities by target_yield/recipe yield up front with Fraction arithmetic; accumulate any result yield_factor into a correction applied to all final quantities so the output stays exactly at target yield.

Apply wording_changes as ordered old->new string replacements over fresh copies of main and component instruction strings; compute final equipment as sorted (original + additions - removals) and check containment in available_equipment.
Treat components as optional: adapt each with a local accumulator, merge on success, omit with a warning on failure.
Guarantee non-mutation by copying every dict/list placed in the output; print_original returns authored_text unchanged.
Include a __main__ self-test covering the seven acceptance scenarios.
mechanisms: priority-and-catalog-order sorted candidate selection for deterministic choices
substitution chain list for cycle detection and reintroduced-exclusion warnings
recursive resolution of additional ingredients sharing the chain (chained adaptation)
exhaustive reason accumulation in a set before the possible/impossible decision
single accumulator context object merged per-component for optional-component omission
Fraction-based scaling plus accumulated yield_factor correction
ordered old->new string replacement for wording changes
copy-on-build output construction to keep inputs immutable
